ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Matthew 7:13–14 is translated from Tolstoy's Russian wording, not from an English Bible. The print has no section 4 (the Ruskin saying stands between sections 3 and 5) and sets Pascal's attribution in the middle of his passage at the page break; both are kept as printed. «Совершенствование» (sovershenstvovanie) is 'perfecting'.
Source observation: [13]-[14] section number 4 is missing: the Ruskin saying follows section 3 directly and is followed by section 5

Source observation: [17] the attribution «Паскаль.» is printed in the middle of the Pascal passage, splitting the sentence «она сама / открылась бы мне» ('it would itself / reveal itself to me') across the page break; kept in place
